title: U.A.E. Announces Halt to Trade With Iran Amid Trump’s Push To Isolate Tehran
summary_full: The Emirates has long been a major trading hub for Iran, and analysts say it has been key to Iranian efforts to evade international sanctions, which Emirati officials deny.
